title: How law firm Gilbert + Tobin governs and scales AI with OpenAI
summary: See how Gilbert + Tobin combines CEO-led commitment, rigorous governance, and human accountability to scale ChatGPT Enterprise and Codex across the firm.
body: See how Gilbert + Tobin combines CEO-led commitment, rigorous governance, and human accountability to scale ChatGPT Enterprise and Codex across the firm.
summaryZh: 本文详细介绍了知名律所Gilbert + Tobin如何通过CEO领导的战略承诺、严谨的企业治理以及人类监督机制，在整个机构中成功规模化应用ChatGPT Enterprise和Codex，展示了大模型在法律服务行业的真实落地和合规治理最佳实践。
